preconditions.description: Attacker must control the contract owner account

exploit_hint: The contract owner has unrestricted access to critical functions including setTaxes(), setWallets(), setBlacklistEnabled(), and sweepContingency(). An attacker with owner privileges can modify tax rates, redirect fee distributions to malicious wallets, blacklist legitimate users, or drain contract funds before liquidity is added. To exploit: 1) Gain control of owner account, 2) Call setWallets() to redirect fee wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, 3) Call setTaxes() to maximize fees up to allowed maximums, 4) Optionally call sweepContingency() to drain any contract balance before _hasLiqBeenAdded is set to true. The owner can also call setExcludedFromFees() to exempt themselves from all taxes while maintaining high taxes for other users.
